events.title: Demo v0.3.4 Retry and Guidance Improvements
events.summary: The demo has been updated to v0.3.4. You can now start another run directly after a defeat. We've also made sausage unlocks and the first steps on the map easier to understand. You can return to the map before starting an elite battle. We've also adjusted the difficulty of floor 7 elites for newly started runs. This update also improves the deck selection layout and text readability. Thank you for playing and sharing your feedback!

events.title: Demo v0.3.3 Chinese Language Support and UI Improvements
events.summary: The demo has been updated to v0.3.3. Simplified and Traditional Chinese are now available. You can change the language in Settings. We've also adjusted the language selection buttons, the title screen layout, and some text and line breaks. If you spot an awkward translation or a display issue, please let us know!

events.title: Demo v0.3.2 — Combat Balance Update
events.summary: The demo has been updated to v0.3.2. We've revisited the increased difficulty in v0.3.1 and brought combat balance closer to v0.3.0. Removed the damage penalty for repeated swings Adjusted stamina consumption and enemy behavior Previous bug fixes, including the icon display fix, remain in place. Thanks to everyone who's played and shared their feedback!

events.title: Demo v0.3.1 Update
events.summary: The demo has been updated to v0.3.1. Adjusted damage and stamina costs for repeated attacks Adjusted attack clashes and enemy behavior Shortened Scream's effect duration Fixed sauce and topping icons Thanks for your feedback and bug reports! Let us know how the update feels.

events.title: Demo v0.3.0 — Improved Controls and Combat Balance
events.summary: We've updated the controls and combat balance based on your feedback. Thank you to everyone who has played the demo! Improved mouse and controller controls Swings now respond more directly to the direction of your input. We've also reduced the feeling of resistance around the center when changing direction with a controller. events.title: Demo Update v0.2.0
events.summary: Thanks for playing the demo! Version 0.2.0 brings improvements to the tutorial, sausage management, and menu controls. Improved the tutorial flow, control prompts, and stamina recovery guidance. Broken sausages now remain in your inventory and can be repaired. Repairs and fusion upgrades are no longer limited to a set number of uses per kitchen visit, as long as you have the required resources. Added a two-sausage bundle to the elite battle reward pool, with at least one Rare or higher sausage.

events.title: The Free Steam Demo Is Out Now!
events.summary: The free demo of Sausage Legend: Arena is now available on Steam! Thank you for waiting and supporting development. Collect, cook, and clash! Sausage Legend: Arena is a roguelite combining physics-based sausage battles with food customization, team building, and map exploration. In the demo, you can play the first half of Chapter 1 of Story Mode.
